assessment: The dollar-top suggestion and explicit twelve-month Bitcoin direction were wrong. QT timing was right. PepsiCo cash returns continued, but volumes and earnings challenged the growth assumption. The Egypt framework usefully distinguishes monetary erosion, while energy use and money supply are incomplete proxies for household welfare.
